025public class GAOutpost extends GABaseMission {
026
027        public static float MISSION_DAYS = 120f;
028        public static float PROB_DESTROYED = 0.5f;
029        public static float PROB_ROGUE_AI = 0.6f;
030        public static float PROB_DESTROYED_PIRATES = 1f/6f;
031        public static float PROB_DESTROYED_PATHERS = 1f/5f; // 4/6 chance for DESTROYED_OTHER
032        public static float PROB_HOSTILE_FLEET = 0.5f;
033        
034        
035        //public static float PROB_PATHER_OR_PIRATE = 0.5f;
036//      public static int RAID_DIFFICULTY = 100;
037//      public static int MARINES_REQUIRED = RAID_DIFFICULTY / 2;
038        
039        
040        public static enum Stage {
041                GO_TO_OUTPOST,
042                RETURN_TO_ACADEMY,
043                COMPLETED,
044                FAILED,
045        }
046        
047        public static enum Variation {
048                BASIC,
049                DESTROYED_PATHERS,
050                DESTROYED_PIRATES,
051                DESTROYED_OTHER,
052                ROGUE_AI,
053        }
054        
055        protected PlanetAPI planet;
056        protected Variation variation;
057        protected PersonAPI leader;
058        protected PersonAPI core;
059        protected int terribleEnd;
060        protected int bizarreProject;
061        
062        @Override
063        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
064                // if this mission type was already accepted by the player, abort
065                if (!setGlobalReference("$gaOp_ref")) {
066                        return false;
067                }
068                
069                pickDepartment(GADepartments.INDUSTRIAL, GADepartments.MILITARY, GADepartments.SCIENCE, GADepartments.WEIRD);
070                
071                if (rollProbability(PROB_DESTROYED)) {
072                        if (rollProbability(PROB_DESTROYED_PIRATES)) {
073                                variation = Variation.DESTROYED_PIRATES;
074                        } else if (rollProbability(PROB_DESTROYED_PATHERS)) {
075                                variation = Variation.DESTROYED_PATHERS;
076                        } else {
077                                variation = Variation.DESTROYED_OTHER;
078                                terribleEnd = genRandom.nextInt(4);
079                        }
080                } else if (rollProbability(PROB_ROGUE_AI)) {
081                        variation = Variation.ROGUE_AI;
082                        bizarreProject = genRandom.nextInt(7);
083                } else {
084                        variation = Variation.BASIC;
085                }
086                
087//              variation = Variation.BASIC;
088//              variation = Variation.DESTROYED_OTHER;
089//              terribleEnd = genRandom.nextInt(4);
090//              variation = Variation.DESTROYED_PATHERS;
091//              PROB_HOSTILE_FLEET = 1f;
092//              variation = Variation.ROGUE_AI;
093//              bizarreProject = genRandom.nextInt(7);
094                
095                resetSearch();
096                
097                //genRandom = new Random();
098//              requireSystemTags(ReqMode.ANY, Tags.THEME_REMNANT, Tags.THEME_DERELICT, 
099//                                                Tags.THEME_MISC, Tags.THEME_MISC_SKIP, Tags.THEME_RUINS);
100                requireSystemTags(ReqMode.NOT_ANY, Tags.SYSTEM_ALREADY_USED_FOR_STORY);
101                preferSystemInteresting();
102                preferSystemOnFringeOfSector();
103                preferSystemUnexplored();
104                requirePlanetNotStar();
105                requirePlanetUnpopulated();
106                requirePlanetNotGasGiant();
107                preferPlanetNotFullySurveyed();
108                preferPlanetInDirectionOfOtherMissions();
109
110                planet = pickPlanet();
111                
112                if (planet == null) {
113                        return false;
114                }
115                
116                setStartingStage(Stage.GO_TO_OUTPOST);
117                addSuccessStages(Stage.COMPLETED);
118                addFailureStages(Stage.FAILED);
119                
120                makeImportant(planet, "$gaOp_targetPlanet", Stage.GO_TO_OUTPOST);
121                makeImportant(getPerson(), "$gaOp_returnHere", Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY);
122                
123                connectWithGlobalFlag(Stage.GO_TO_OUTPOST, Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY, "$gaOp_needToReturn");
124                setStageOnGlobalFlag(Stage.COMPLETED, "$gaOp_completed");
125                
126                if (WITH_TIME_LIMIT) {
127                        setTimeLimit(Stage.FAILED, MISSION_DAYS, planet.getStarSystem(), Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY);
128                }
129                //setCreditReward(40000, 50000);
130                setCreditReward(CreditReward.AVERAGE);
131                setDefaultGARepRewards();
132                
133                leader = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT).createRandomPerson(genRandom);
134                leader.setRankId(Ranks.CITIZEN);
135                leader.setPostId(Ranks.POST_ACADEMICIAN);
136                
137                core = new AICoreOfficerPluginImpl().createPerson(Commodities.BETA_CORE, Factions.NEUTRAL, genRandom);
138                
139                
140                if (variation == Variation.DESTROYED_PIRATES && rollProbability(PROB_HOSTILE_FLEET)) {
141                        beginStageTrigger(Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY);
142                        triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.PIRATES, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, planet);
143                        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthModerate();
144                        triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
145                        triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(planet, 3000f);
146                        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation(null, null);
147                        triggerOrderFleetPatrol(planet);
148                        endTrigger();
149                } else if (variation == Variation.DESTROYED_PATHERS && rollProbability(PROB_HOSTILE_FLEET)) {
150                        beginStageTrigger(Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY);
151                        triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, Factions.LUDDIC_PATH, FleetTypes.PATROL_MEDIUM, planet);
152                        triggerAutoAdjustFleetStrengthModerate();
153                        triggerFleetAllowLongPursuit();
154                        triggerFleetPatherNoDefaultTithe();
155                        triggerPickLocationAroundEntity(planet, 3000f);
156                        triggerSpawnFleetAtPickedLocation(null, null);
157                        triggerOrderFleetPatrol(planet);
158                        endTrigger();
159                }
160                
161                return true;
162        }
163        
164        @Override
165        protected boolean callAction(String action, String ruleId, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, List<Token> params,
166                                                                Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
167                if (dialog != null && action.equals("showLeader")) {
168                        showPersonInfo(leader, dialog, false, false);
169                        return true;
170                }
171                if (dialog != null && action.equals("showCore")) {
172                        showPersonInfo(core, dialog, false, false);
173                        return true;
174                }
175                if (dialog != null && action.equals("doubleReward")) {
176                        setCreditReward(getCreditsReward() * 2);
177                        return true;
178                }
179                return false;
180        }
181

189                set("$gaOp_leaderHeOrShe", leader.getHeOrShe());
190                set("$gaOp_leaderHisOrHer", leader.getHisOrHer());
191                //variation = Variation.BASIC;
192                set("$gaOp_variation", variation);
193                set("$gaOp_terribleEnd", terribleEnd);
194                set("$gaOp_bizarreProject", bizarreProject);
195                set("$gaOp_destroyed", variation == Variation.DESTROYED_OTHER || 
196                                                           variation == Variation.DESTROYED_PATHERS ||
197                                                           variation == Variation.DESTROYED_PIRATES);
198//              if (variation == Variation.DECIV) {
199//                      set("$gaOp_marinesReq", MARINES_REQUIRED);
200//                      set("$gaOp_raidDifficulty", RAID_DIFFICULTY);
201//              } else if (variation == Variation.PULSAR) {
202//                      PlanetAPI pulsar = Misc.getPulsarInSystem(planet.getStarSystem());
203//                      if (pulsar != null) {
204//                              set("$gaOp_pulsarName", planet.getStarSystem().getNameWithNoType());
205//                      }
206//              }
207        }
208        
209        @Override
210        public void addDescriptionForNonEndStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
211                float opad = 10f;
212                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
213                if (currentStage == Stage.GO_TO_OUTPOST) {
214                        info.addPara(getGoToPlanetTextPre(planet) +
215                                        ", and drop off a small team of scientists at an outpost located there.", opad);
216                } else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY) {
217                        info.addPara("Return to the Galatia Academy and talk to " + 
218                                                 getPerson().getNameString() + " to receive your reward.", opad);
219                }
220        }
221
222        @Override
223        public boolean addNextStepText(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
224                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
225                if (currentStage == Stage.GO_TO_OUTPOST) {
226                        info.addPara(getGoToPlanetTextShort(planet), tc, pad);
227                        return true;
228                } else if (currentStage == Stage.RETURN_TO_ACADEMY) {
229                        info.addPara("Return to the Galatia Academy and talk to " + getPerson().getNameString(), tc, pad);
230                        return true;
231                }
232                return false;
233        }
234
235        @Override
236        public String getBaseName() {
237                return "Science Team Transport";
238        }
